controls.title: Controls
controls.idleHint: Click a key slot to rebind
controls.captureHint: Press any key, Esc to cancel, Backspace to clear

first_catch.description: The tide brought you to Anchor Hollow. The Fisherman offered a rod and a simple deal: catch a fish, then we talk. Pull your first catch from the island's waters.

travellers_errand.description: A small favor for a stranger on the road. Hear them out, then report back to the Guard.

heed_the_warning.description: The Guard doesn't think you can last 60 seconds past the bridge. Prove him wrong, then tell him about it.

anti_death_measures.description: The Merchant's first survival lesson: find a Yekbush, harvest yekberries, and learn why a blade-cat never goes out empty-pawed.

merchant_side_brew.description: Lesson two from the Merchant. Stomp yekberries into liquid, bottle the juice with a jar, and drink to something stronger than survival food.

village_weirdo.description: The Traveller wants exactly 19 yekberries. You'll find out why when you bring them.

wares_galore.description: Word's out that you have coin. The Merchant would like a word. A long one.

bowl_that_shines.description: The Wise Man holds a secret. He says take it to the Sea Master. The Sea Master says the docks, at night, under moonlight. Somewhere between those two is the Glimmering Key and the chest it opens.

wizards_scar.description: The Wise Man senses the Glimmerbowl's awakening and sends you to a reclusive Wizard. Convince the Wizard you're worth his time, learn about scars, and forge your first one.

bowlThatShines.returnToSeamaster: Bring the key back to the Sea Master. He's been waiting for this longer than you've been alive.

wizardsScar.activateBowl: Click on the world to activate your Glimmerbowl.

rod.openInventory: To equip your new rod, open your inventory (press {key} on desktop).
rod.openInventoryMobile: To equip your new rod, tap the inventory button.
rod.selectRod: Click your rod in the inventory to select it.
rod.equipRod: Click the rod equipment slot on the right to equip it.
rod.closeInventoryMobile: Tap the inventory button again to close your inventory.

fishing.useRod: You're near water. Press {key} (desktop) or click the rod button to start fishing.
fishing.holdCast: Hold the cast button for a few seconds, then release.
fishing.reel: Click the reel button repeatedly until you catch the fish.
fishing.stop: Great catch! Click Stop Fishing, then talk to the Fisherman.

food.openInventoryMobile: Open your inventory to get your berry ready.
food.selectBerry: Click the yekberries in your inventory.
food.explainScore: That red +20 is the food score. In this basic form, yekberries only heal about 1 out of 5 uses.
food.equipQuickslot1: Move the yekberries into quick slot 1 on the right.
food.closeInventoryMobile: Close your inventory to try the quick slot.
food.stabHeartLoss: STAB! You just lost a heart! Now we'll use the berry to heal up.
food.consumeQuickslot1: Now click quick slot 1 to eat. This tutorial forces a heal so you can see it, but +20 food score normally means about a 1/5 chance.

interaction.useInteract: Use this interact button for most world and character interactions.

greeting.0: Hey! Nice timing, I was just polishing my knife.

choice.askRod: Can I get a fishing rod?

hasRod.0: Good to see you already geared up. Go reel in something sharp!

noRod.0: Well hello there! You look unarmed. Take this fishing rod.

hasRod.0: Hey now... I ALREADY GAVE YOU A ROD! NOW SCRAM!!!

noRod.0: Ugh, fine. But you better not mess up my fishing spot!

greeting.0: Tides are honest. Keep your blade sharp, and your heart sharper.

passphrase.prompt: If you have business with me, say it plainly.

choice.1: The collector of glass sent me.

wrong.0: Who do you think you are? I'm not giving you anything... not one bronze coin.
wrong.1: Never heard of him. Never heard of you. Scram.

story.0: The Wise Man doesn't hand that code to just anyone. If he trusted you, I suppose I'll have to.
story.1: Listen close. Before the salt, I was a dust creature — an archaeologist, desert-bred, expedition-fed.
story.2: One dig, I pried up a chest that didn't match any century I knew.
story.3: My sources — don't ask — told me the key was lost somewhere in the dunes I'd already walked past.
story.4: So I hauled the chest to Anchor Hollow and never looked back. Swore to the sea. Learned every current it would teach.
story.5: Chasing that key, I became the Sea Master.
story.6: And now I grant you the privilege of helping me chase what I can't catch.
story.7: It's under the docks somewhere. I can feel it the way you feel a tide turning.
story.8: Ask around town. And mind who you trust — this place has its share of weirdos. Suspicious. Weird. You'll know them by the smell.

choice.justMet: ... I kinda met him 30 seconds ago
choice.pals: Yes, we've been pals for life!

choiceResponse.justMet: Thirty seconds? Hmph. Then your timing is suspiciously perfect.
choiceResponse.pals: Pals for life, at your size? Only if life started last Tuesday. Fine. Close enough.

player.0: What have you managed to piece together so far?

postKey.0: By the rolling tide... that's the Glimmering Key.
postKey.1: Thirty years of current charts, and a stranger finds it in a week. Fate has a cruel sense of comedy.
postKey.2: Keep what's inside. All of it. I've taken enough from the sea for one lifetime.
postKey.3: Go on. The chest has been waiting longer than you've been alive. Don't make it wait more.

finalPlaceholder.0: So. Did the chest show you what I thought it would? Don't answer yet.
finalPlaceholder.1: Sit with it. Dream on it. Come find me when the shine has settled into something you can carry.

greeting.0: Stay sharp. Anchor Hollow is quiet — and quiet is a job.

preUnlock.0: HEY — it's not safe out there. GET BACK TO TOWN before I have to tell your dad. Kidding. Mostly.

bridgeBlocked.0: HOLD YOUR HORSES — nobody crosses this bridge without me knowing their business first!

intro.0: WOAH — where do you think YOU'RE going?
intro.1: What's over that bridge, huh? A spa? A bakery? Spoiler: wilder than that. And you're not ready.
intro.3: Alright, fine. Prove it. Cross the bridge. Stay alive over there. Sixty seconds. On the clock.
intro.4: HA! Okay. May the tides favor you. And the wind. And literally anything else!

choice.exploring: Uhhh... I'm just exploring I guess?

wait.0: Bridge. Sixty seconds. Danger zone. Then you come running back. Hopefully attached to yourself.

return.0: WHAT — how — HOW did you survive that?
return.1: Okay. Okay. Color me... not prepared for that. Not many folks in Anchor Hollow last thirty seconds out there, let alone sixty.
return.2: Tell you what, kid. When you're geared up and serious, find me again. I'll teach you how to actually fight what's over there — not just outrun it.
return.3: You'll know when you're ready. Everyone does. Until then — don't get eaten.

reaction.yay: 'Yay'?? You just outran death and your reaction is 'yay.' I love it. I love this.
reaction.hooray: HOORAY! That's the correct amount of volume for someone who forgot to be scared!
reaction.cool: 'Cool.' Look at you. Too cool for survival. Fine. Fine.

post.0: Come back when you've got the gear and the guts. You're close. You're not quite there.

askAround.0: A LOST KEY? Oh, kid, if I had the key to everything, I'd RETIRE.
askAround.1: I don't know about this one. Not a guard thing. Ask someone who actually LISTENS to the rumor mill.

intro.0: Huh. The tide dragged in something new.
intro.1: Anchor Hollow. Little island, big ocean.
intro.2: Most haven't. Storm brought you in?
intro.3: A cure. Hm. Can't help you there, kid. I know fish. That's about it.
intro.4: But first — you look half-drowned and fully starved. Can't look for anything on an empty stomach.
intro.5: Fishing's how we survive out here. I'll set you up.
intro.6: Land one and come back to me. Then we'll talk more.

player.1: Anchor Hollow? I've never heard of this place.
player.2: I was sailing from home. My dad is sick — really sick. I left to find a cure for him.

choice.cure: Has anyone come here looking for something like that?

island.0: Small. Quiet. Handful of us live here. We fish, we eat, we mind our business.
island.1: There's a town further in. Guard watches the bridge, merchant sells things, couple others.
island.2: They'd know more about the world than I do. I just know the water.

cure.0: People wash up looking for all kinds of things. Most of them find fish.
cure.1: But the island's got old things in it. Older than the docks. Older than me.
cure.2: Talk to the folks in town. Someone might point you somewhere.

choice.prompt: What do I need to do?
choice.howFish: Wait — how does fishing even work?

hasRod.0: You've already got one. Good. Find water, cast the line, and reel when it tugs.

noRod.0: Here. She's rickety, but she catches. Don't drop her in the water.
noRod.1: Equip it, walk to the water's edge, and cast. When the line pulls — reel.

howFish.0: Equip the rod. Stand near water. Cast the line.
howFish.1: When you feel a tug, that's a bite. Reel it in before it swims off.
howFish.2: Oh — you'll need one of these.

reminder.0: Still dry? The water's right there, kid.
reminder.1: Cast the line. Reel when it bites. Bring me what you catch.

postCatch.0: Ha! Look at that. Your first catch.
postCatch.1: Don't let the fish hear you say that.
postCatch.2: You did good, kid. Natural grip. Most newcomers yank too hard and snap the line.
postCatch.3: There's always more. Better rods, deeper water, rarer fish. The basics get you fed. Everything past that gets you rich.
postCatch.5: Something old. Past where the lines reach. I've fished these docks longer than I care to count, and I've never touched the edge of it.
postCatch.6: Not my business, though. I catch what bites.
postCatch.7: Head into town, kid. Meet the Guard, the Merchant. They'll teach you things I can't.
postCatch.8: And if you ever need the water — I'll be here. I'm always here.

player.0: That was... actually kind of fun?
player.1: So there's more to it than just reeling?

askAround.1: Never pulled one out of the water. My trade is fish, not secrets.
askAround.2: Try someone who watches people. That's not my hour.

greeting.0: Light pack, heavy heart. I can fix both — for the right price.

intro.1: Alright. Step one of commerce: do you have any coin?
intro.3: Not one? How are you even upright in Anchor Hollow?
intro.4: I'm new here. Still figuring it out.
intro.5: Alright, alright. I'll help. No coin today — we'll skip straight to survival. Find a Yekbush nearby and pick some yekberries.
intro.6: Come back when you've harvested. Then we'll talk about real food.

harvest.0: Yekbush. Nearby. Pick some yekberries. Bitter, barely filling — but they keep a blade-cat upright.
harvest.1: One bush's worth. That's all. Come back and I'll call you battle-ready.

return.0: Good haul. Those yekberries keep fighters standing when standing is the whole job.
return.1: This is step one. Come back when you want the advanced method and I'll show you how to refine food.
return.2: Slot a few. Use them before the panic hits, not during. Panic uses them wrong.

player.0: So this is just... survival food?

intro.0: Back for lesson two? Good. Raw food keeps you alive. Refined food wins fights.
intro.1: Always. First trick: pressure extraction. Sounds fancy. It isn't.
intro.2: Drop your berries on the ground. Stomp them into liquid. Come tell me when it's a puddle.

player.0: So spending time on prep actually matters?

stomp.0: Drop the berries. Walk over them. Several times. Not gracefully.
stomp.1: No dainty steps. Mash them like they insulted your knife.

jar.0: Perfect stomp. You reduced those berries to an insult of their former selves.
jar.1: Puddles slip through paws. Use a jar. I'll spot you one. Once.
jar.2: Next jar, you pay. Glass doesn't grow on trees — unless trees have really changed while I wasn't looking.

collect.0: You've got juice. Now bottle it. Tap the puddle. Confirm the pour.
collect.1: One jar in, one Yek Juice out. Chemistry. Consequences.

finish.0: NOW that is fuel. Clean, sharp, and it actually keeps a blade-cat on its feet.
finish.1: Exactly. Skill in the kitchen is skill in combat — with fewer screams.
finish.2: Come back soon. Anchor Hollow feeds the ones who experiment. I'll teach you recipes that bite back.

player.0: That healed way better than the raw berries.

intro.0: Heard a rumor on the wind — you've got coin now. True?
intro.1: Marvelous. A customer with actual currency is my favorite kind of miracle.
intro.2: Come see the stall. First look is on the house. First look only.

post.0: You've got the walk of a paying customer. Stall's open.
post.1: Back again? A shopkeeper loves a loyal nose.
post.2: Coins? I have the thing. I have several things. I have a specific thing for you.
post.3: Welcome back. Fresh stock. Fair prices. Mostly fair.

askAround.0: A lost key? Not on my shelf. I sell what I can count — and rumors don't stack.
askAround.1: Try somebody who trades in whispers. I'm a knife-and-jar operation.

clue.1: A key. Hm. I heard this once, sitting on the docks alone: when the sky goes dark and the stars get loud, the moon spills treasure across the water.
clue.2: If you're hunting a key — docks, after nightfall. Go look.

intro.0: A traveler's request, then. Bring me 19 yekberries. Exactly 19.
intro.1: Specific goals build character. Please. Thank you.

collect.0: Still waiting on those 19 yekberries. I keep my bargains specific — no one has an excuse.

return.0: You actually came back. With exactly 19 yekberries. Hm.
return.1: Confession — I wasn't really hungry. I wanted to see if anyone in this town still looks a stranger in the eye.
return.2: Fair. It's a quiet way to run a test.
return.3: Here — one silver. Not much. Silver has a way of becoming useful anyway.
return.4: You've never had a coin? What, were you raised under a rock? Don't answer.
return.5: One silver coin is worth a hundred bronze.
return.6: A hundred silver make one gold.
return.7: A single silver looks small. Spent carefully, it becomes exactly what you need.

player.1: I've never had a coin before...

post.0: How's the silver treating you? Spend it wisely. Not stylishly.

greeting.0: A quiet mind hears what loud waves hide.

intro.3: I'll give you a secret. It trades weight on your shoulders for weight behind your eyes. I suspect you can carry it.
intro.5: Tell him, word for word: the collector of glass sent you.
intro.6: Those exact words. A single word out of place and he'll turn you away.

choice.prompt: Do I want to hear it?

reminder.0: Find the Sea Master. Say these exact words: the collector of glass sent you. Nothing more, nothing different.

askAround.0: I've said my piece. The rest is yours to find.
askAround.1: Keys choose their owners. Stop chasing and start listening.

intro.0: Hold still. Something is... different about you. There's a hum. A vibration. You've awakened the Glimmerbowl, haven't you?
intro.1: The Glimmerbowl is no ordinary tool. Long ago, creatures of the deep sea forged it from moonstone and tide-glass. They believed that every fish carried a fragment of a soul—and this bowl was the key to channeling those fragments.
intro.2: Only those whose spirit is in tune with the sea can command it. And it seems... you are one of the very few.
intro.3: But raw power without understanding is a storm without a harbor. You need guidance. There is someone who can help—a Wizard who lives on the outskirts of town.
intro.4: Find the Wizard. Tell him these exact words: "The bowl scavenger sent me." He'll know what it means.
intro.5: His bark is worse than his bite. Probably. Go now, and don't forget the phrase.

player.0: The Glimmerbowl? I mean, I found it, but I don't really understand what it does.
player.1: Fragments of a soul? That sounds... intense.
player.2: Another password? Seriously? Does anyone on this island just talk to each other normally?
player.3: Fine. "The bowl scavenger sent me." Got it. I think.

reminder.0: The Wizard is waiting. Tell him: "The bowl scavenger sent me." And try not to annoy him. Too much.

intro.0: I fear this is it, kid. The big cat nap. The eternal sunbeam.
intro.1: Don't talk like that, Pop. You're just... coughing up a really big hairball. You'll be fine.
intro.2: No... no. I've done the math. I survived the Vacuum War of '12. I survived falling off the fridge. I even survived that time I ate the shiny plastic wrapper. That's eight lives, kid. I'm on number nine. The tank is empty.
intro.3: There is... a way. A legend the Old Toms used to whisper back on the mainland. A cure. Enough to stretch one more life out of a cat who ran out.
intro.4: A tenth life? That's a myth. Like the Infinite Red Dot.
intro.5: It's real. I can feel it in my jellies. But I'm too weak to hunt for it. You... you have to be the one. You have to find the—
intro.6: The only way I keep breathing is if you bring me the—
intro.8: Pop? Pop! The what?? The WHAT, Pop?!
intro.11: Fine. I'll find it. Whatever "it" is. Anything for pops.

fallback.0: Come here, kid. Let me look at you while I still can.

0.0: There you are. Closer. These old whiskers can't pick you out of a sunbeam anymore.
0.1: I've been thinking about it. About what I left undone. Your name wasn't on that list.
0.2: You don't need a prophecy. You need a sharp knife and a full belly. Go get both.

1.1: I used to patrol the living room like it was a battlefield. Couch to fridge. Fridge to window. Legendary routes. Gone now.
1.2: Keep moving for both of us, yeah? I'll nap for both of us.

2.0: Back again. Good. You smell like salt and adventure. That's my favorite smell.
2.1: Every great cat who ever did anything started out not knowing a single thing. You're early. That's all you are.
2.2: You really think I can do this?
2.3: I don't think. I know. I'm a cat. We don't do 'think.'

3.0: The world's gotten stranger since I was your age. Bigger and more bruised.
3.1: But strange is where cats live, kid. You were born for strange. I made sure.
3.2: Don't walk it alone. Pick a small crew. One cat's trust is worth ten strangers' promises.

4.0: Want to know the thing that kept me moving all those years on the mainland?
4.2: The thought of coming home and watching you fall asleep on warm laundry. And now you're the one heading out.
4.3: Make it count, kid. I'll be right here. Resting my eyes. Mostly resting.

5.0: Hmm? Oh. Just resting my eyes. Professionally.
5.1: Listen. Whatever you run into out there — remember you're my kid.
5.2: My kid has sharp knives. My kid doesn't flinch. My kid comes home.

arrival.crash: Oops... looks like I fell asleep.

greeting.0: What. You again? I'm busy. Go bother someone with less important things to do.

intro.0: What do you want? I don't have time for small talk. Or big talk. Or any talk.
intro.1: Oh, a passphrase. How quaint. How delightfully pedestrian. You think a string of words entitles you to my time?

password.0: "The bowl scavenger." Wonderful. So the old man is still sending strays to my door. That doesn't change anything.
password.1: But I was told you could help me understand—

player.0: Wait, you know who sent me?

bowl.0: A Glimmerbowl. Fascinating. Everyone and their grandmother claims to have one these days. Mostly it's a soup bowl with glitter.
bowl.1: This one is real! The Wise Man said—

player.0: But it's really a Glimmerbowl! Look!
Uh... hello? The Wise Man sent me. I have a password.

autoResume.1: Did you just... did the bowl actually respond to you? Out here? Without a scar, without a binding, without anything?
autoResume.2: That's... that shouldn't be possible. The Glimmerbowl doesn't just activate for anyone. It chooses. And it chose YOU.
autoResume.3: I've spent decades studying these artifacts and I've never seen someone command one raw like that. Not once.
autoResume.4: Sit down. No, stand up. No—just stay where you are. We need to talk about scars.
autoResume.5: A scar is a magical sigil. When applied to a fish, it awakens something dormant inside the creature. The fish becomes a figment of your soul—your thoughts, your will, fused into its being.
autoResume.6: From that point on, that fish doesn't just swim. It fights. For you. Through the Glimmerbowl. Your intent becomes its action. Your resolve becomes its strength.
autoResume.7: I can make you one. A Nightfire Scar. It's entry-level as far as scars go, but for someone at your stage it'll be more than enough.
autoResume.8: But I need materials. Ten jars. Empty ones. The binding ritual requires glass vessels to contain the sigil while it forms. Here—take these coins. Two silver should cover it.
autoResume.9: Now go. Get the jars. Don't dawdle. And don't break them.

player.1: A figment of my soul? That's... kind of beautiful. And kind of terrifying.
player.2: Ten jars. Two silver. Got it. I'll be back.

jarReminder.0: Ten jars. Empty. Glass. Not broken. Is any of this getting through?

jarReturn.0: You got them. All ten. And none of them are cracked. I'm almost impressed.
jarReturn.1: Here they are! All ten, safe and sound.
jarReturn.2: Good. Now don't move. Don't talk. Don't even think too loudly. This is delicate work.

scarComplete.0: It's done. The Nightfire Scar. Take it. Handle it carefully—it's more fragile than it looks, and more powerful than you deserve.
scarComplete.1: When you're ready, apply it to a fish. You'll know what to do. Probably. Maybe. Just don't waste it.

goldenberries.name: Golden Berries
goldenberries.description: A rare, sweet berry that restores vitality.

yekberries.name: Yek Berries
yekberries.description: Tart berries from a yekbush. Simple, reliable healing food.

yekjuice.name: Yek Juice
yekjuice.description: Pressed yek juice in drinkable form. Much more nourishing than raw berries.

yekjuiceliquid.name: Yek Juice Liquid
yekjuiceliquid.description: A fresh puddle of crushed yek juice. Collect it with a jar.

jar.name: Jar
jar.description: A glass jar used to gather liquids.

glimmeringkey.name: Glimmering Key
glimmeringkey.description: A pale key that catches moonlight even in murky water.

nightfire_scar.name: Nightfire Scar
nightfire_scar.description: A burning sigil that can awaken a fish into free will.

tuna.name: Tuna
tuna.description: A common tuna fish. Delicious when prepared properly.

mackerel.name: Mackerel
mackerel.description: A sleek mackerel with shimmering scales.

cod.name: Cod
cod.description: A plump cod fish, common in temperate waters.

salmon.name: Salmon
salmon.description: A pink salmon, prized for its rich flavor.

catfish.name: Catfish
catfish.description: A whiskered catfish that lurks in deeper waters.

fat_tuna.name: Fat Tuna
fat_tuna.description: An exceptionally plump tuna. Worth more than its regular counterpart.

fat_mackerel.name: Fat Mackerel
fat_mackerel.description: A chunky mackerel with extra meat.

fat_cod.name: Fat Cod
fat_cod.description: An oversized cod, quite the catch!

fat_salmon.name: Fat Salmon
fat_salmon.description: A hefty salmon bursting with flavor.

fat_catfish.name: Fat Catfish
fat_catfish.description: A massive catfish. Its whiskers are impressively long.

coho_salmon.name: Coho Salmon
coho_salmon.description: A beautiful coho salmon with distinctive silver markings.

rickety_rod.name: Rickety Rod
rickety_rod.description: A worn fishing rod held together with hope and string.

fisherman_rod.name: Fisherman's Rod
fisherman_rod.description: A reliable fishing rod used by experienced anglers.

developer_rod.name: Developer Rod
developer_rod.description: A debug rod tuned for very fast test catches.

sea_grass.name: Sea Grass
sea_grass.description: A clump of sea grass. Not particularly useful.

boot.name: Old Boot
boot.description: A waterlogged boot. Someone lost this ages ago.

broken_bottle.name: Broken Bottle
broken_bottle.description: Shards of a broken glass bottle. Handle with care.

apple_core.name: Apple Core
apple_core.description: The remains of someone's snack. Very fresh, oddly.

trash_bag.name: Trash Bag
trash_bag.description: A soggy trash bag. Who throws these in the water?

sea_pickle.name: Sea Pickle
sea_pickle.description: A bioluminescent sea pickle. Kinda cute, actually.

broken_specs.name: Broken Spectacles
broken_specs.description: Someone's lost glasses. They probably can't read now.

infested_boot.name: Infested Boot
infested_boot.description: An old boot now home to mysterious sea creatures.

infested_vase.name: Infested Vase
infested_vase.description: An ancient vase covered in barnacles. Could be valuable!

ruined_chest.name: Ruined Chest
ruined_chest.description: A waterlogged treasure chest. Most contents have rotted away.
